description: Na₂Mg(SbO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.94 Å. Mg is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.66 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.23 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.11 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgSb₂ square pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgSb₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgSb₂ square pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom.
